about.title: About — UniSkilled
about.uniskilled-connects-university-s: UniSkilled connects university students with peers who need help in the courses they've already passed. Tutoring is live today; freelance projects for businesses are next.
about.of-every-one-to-one-booking: Of every one-to-one booking goes to the tutor
about.peer-tutoring-is-live: Peer tutoring is live now — students teach the courses they know. A freelance marketplace, where students take on projects for businesses, is coming next.
about.tutors-earn-the-verified: Tutors earn the ✓ Verified badge by confirming a code sent to their university inbox — so you can see at a glance who's been checked. Payments are held by UniSkilled until 48 hours after each session, so there's time to report a problem before the tutor is paid.
about.student-signs-up-as: Student signs up as a tutor
about.any-email-works-to: Any email works to sign up. To earn the Verified badge, they confirm a code sent to their university inbox.
about.they-list-the-subjects: They list the subjects they can teach
about.set-their-rate-and: Set their rate and availability. All sessions take place online.
about.students-book-and-pay: Students book and pay through the platform
about.youre-only-charged-once: You're only charged once the tutor accepts. Payment is then held until 48 hours after the session.
about.tutor-is-paid-automatically: Tutor is paid automatically after the session
about.funds-are-released-48: Funds are released 48 hours after the session, unless an issue has been reported.
about.business-posts-a-job: Business posts a job or browses student profiles
about.student-applies-or-business: Student applies or business places an order
about.students-apply-with-their: Students apply with their profile and portfolio.
about.business-funds-escrow-work: Business pays, payment is held — work begins
about.student-is-protected-business: Student is protected. Business is protected. No money changes hands until delivery.
about.the-platform-fee-is: The platform fee is deducted and the student receives the rest.
about.uniskilled-tutoring-sessions-hap: UniSkilled tutoring sessions happen online — live and interactive. Tutors share screens, explain concepts, and answer questions in real time. Just like being in the same room.
about.live-video-sessions-screen: 📹 Live video sessions 🖥️ Screen sharing 💬 In-session chat 📝 Session notes 🎓 Verified tutor badges ⏱️ Flexible scheduling
about.verified-tutor-mathematics-3: 🎓 Verified tutor 📐 Mathematics 👥 3 students
about.you-already-have-skills: You already have skills that people will pay for. UniSkilled gives you the platform to earn from them — with verified credentials that follow you into your career.
about.offer-tutoring-in-your: Offer tutoring in your subject area
about.offer-freelance-skills-to: Offer freelance skills to real businesses
about.get-paid-through-secure: Get paid securely, with every payment held by UniSkilled
about.access-verified-motivated-studen: Access verified, motivated student talent — coming soon. Pay a fraction of agency rates. Hire the talent you've already worked with full-time after graduation.
about.post-jobs-students-apply: Post jobs — students apply in minutes
about.protected-escrow-pay-only: Payment held — released only on delivery
about.build-a-talent-pool: Build a talent pool of reliable students
about.uniskilled-helps-your-students: UniSkilled helps your students build real-world experience and earn while they study — with verified credentials that can be officially recognised as extracurricular achievement.
about.students-earn-verified-credentia: Students earn verified credentials on platform
about.no-university-permission-or: No university permission or integration required
about.tutors-confirm-their-university: Tutors confirm their university email before the ✓ Verified badge appears. Businesses will verify with a work email when the marketplace opens.
about.all-payments-go-through: All payments are held by UniSkilled. Tutors are paid 48 hours after each session. If something goes wrong, it can be reported before any money is released.
about.platform-fees-are-low: Platform fees are low and transparent. Businesses pay less than agency rates. Students keep most of what they earn. No hidden charges.
about.every-completed-session-and: Every completed session and review builds a tutor's track record, with a certificate they can share.
about.multiple-currencies-gdpr-complia: Multiple currencies. GDPR compliant. EU-hosted data. Designed for students studying abroad, international programmes, and universities everywhere.
about.we-do-not-sell: We do not sell user data. We do not run ads. Student CVs and documents are private. You control what is visible on your profile at all times.
about.no-badge-without-proof-2: No badge without proof. Tutors confirm their university email before the ✓ Verified badge appears.
about.payments-are-held-by: Payments are held by UniSkilled until 48 hours after the session. Both sides protected.
about.a-real-person-reviews: A real person reviews every reported issue and can refund in full or in part.
about.eu-hosted-gdpr-compliant-your-da: EU-hosted, GDPR-compliant. Your data is yours — export or delete it anytime.
about.tutoring-is-fully-running: Tutoring is fully running today. Freelance projects reuse the same verification and payment protection, and are being built now.

about.sign-up-with-any: Sign up with any email. No subscription required to join.
about.im-a-student-im: 🎓 I'm a student 🏢 I'm a business 🏛️ University partnership
about.the-global-student-talent: The global student talent platform. Verified skills, protected payments, and built for international students — wherever you study.
about.meta.description: UniSkilled is a university-verified tutoring marketplace connecting students with peer tutors who have taken the same courses.
about.meta.og-description: UniSkilled is a university-verified tutoring marketplace connecting students with peer tutors who have taken the same courses.
